title: Unit Event — Aim Higher and Higher!

meta.Outline: The day of Taiga and Ken's event has finally arrived. The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD are looking forward to this world-class event, when an incident leads to an unexpected reunion.

rows.Line: Morning
New York - Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Alright, we sound pretty good.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm glad we asked Taiga and the others about places near our hotel where we can sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And singing somewhere different has a nice sense of freshness to it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This still isn't good enough.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We need our voices to really resonate!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we'll go get some drinks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll buy some for you guys, too, so sit tight!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright. Thank you both.
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for helping us practice, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Not a problem. I had a lot of fun singing with you. I have to say, though...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You seem extra motivated today, Kohane.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I felt it too. Your voice is always powerful, but you seem to be really channeling your feelings today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My feelings...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I suppose so.
I do believe that I need to keep trying harder.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Especially considering what happened in SEKAI the other day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you referring to the dream those black fragments showed us?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. In that dream, the four of us were totally separated. It really drove home that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I need to treasure the time we get to sing together. Because I want to stand on top of the world, the four of us, together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. It sounds like that experience is really spurring you on.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That said... I still don't really know what it means to “stand on top of the world”.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It is a massive goal.
It's difficult to picture it clearly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I agree.
But there's no need to rush to find an answer.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I mean, you're all still discovering your new dream, right?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You'll visit new places and experience new things in the future, so I think it's okay for you to all figure things out as you go along.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And eventually, you'll find what “standing on top of the world” means to you.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. For now, let's focus on doing what we can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And we're seeing Taiga's event today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Maybe we'll pick something up there!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Is something the matter, Toya?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
Ken has watched and helped us practice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we haven't heard Taiga sing since that time we battled against him.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Taiga seemed so insurmountable then.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I didn't know if we'd ever be able to overcome him. I was afraid to even try. But now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's funny, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What is?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Back then, I never would've imagined everything that's happened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: After hearing Taiga sing, I was so scared we might not actually be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we trained like nothing else mattered, and we managed to break through that enormous wall. And now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here we are, in real life.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, there was never a dull moment. It's almost dizzying in retrospect...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You really have been through a lot.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah... But we've gotten to see and do so many different things. And we've grown so much as a result.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to what we're going to see next, starting with the event today!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
We should enjoy what the world's stage has to offer us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, what's today's event going to be like? You said that it's supposed to be really big.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's called “SONIC NOTES”.
It's still a relatively new event, so we don't know much about it either.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But after a world-class label became a sponsor last year, the event has absolutely exploded in prestige and lineup both.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Artists from around the world are going to perform, right? I can't wait!
se_walk_men_001_2
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're back! We got water for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, welcome back, you two!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry about the wait.
Here's yours.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Let's resume practice after you two have had a chance to rest.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, can I sing while you guys take your break?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I came up with a new arrangement for that part we just practiced, and I really want to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sure.
Then, we'll listen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks! Here it goes...
se_walk_women_001_3
se_walk_women_001_1

*Sigh*
“Thank goodness I was able to snag some ice cream♪”
“I don't know how you can eat that stuff so early in the morning. Don't come crying to me later if you get a stomachache.”

“I'll be fine!
Let's go home so I can eat this.”
“Oh, someone's singing over there.”
“Look at that. Not many people are out this early...”

“Hey, she's really good!
I wanna talk to her!”

“Yes, she has a nice voice.
And she seems very skilled...”
“Hmm... But you really shouldn't interrupt her.”
“Because I know you're going to ask to sing with her, Elena. And if you do, your ice cream's going to melt.”

“What?!
I wouldn't... No, I would...”

“But I really feel like singing now!
So, why don't we sing together later?”
“Hmm... Okay, after we get home, and you have your ice cream. It's been a little bit, so why don't we hit up you-know-where?”
“Yay! I'll make quick work of it♪”
A few hours later
Outside the hotel
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, I'm late, you two!
I realized that I forgot my wallet when I was already in the elevator!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously, good job forgetting your wallet when we're going shopping. You wouldn't have gotten much done.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I'm glad you noticed before we left.
Anyway, now that we're all here, shall we?
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so excited for this flea market. It's one of the most famous ones in New York, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! We gotta thank our lucky stars that it's being held at the same time as SONIC NOTES! And it's right by the event venue too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The event begins in the evening, so we should be able to take our time browsing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miku said she'd come visit later, so I hope she also gets to have some fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Me too.
Oh, a right at this corner and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Why are all those people gathered around?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I hear music. Does that mean someone's singing?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But that's a huge crowd.
Who's singing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This power... I'm feeling their voices in my gut.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Hey, there they are! Over there!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “You were right. I can't believe they're here. We really get to hear illys sing!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: illys...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It sounds like they're pretty well-known around these parts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
They sound amazing...!
Wanna get a little closer, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, no need to rush...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I also wanna hear more.
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(...!
That was a tricky transition, but they were in perfect unison!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “They're totally in sync! You can tell that they're sisters!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Hey, being sisters isn't what makes them great. Elena and Rebecca are just on another level entirely.”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They're good...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes. We've seen quite a number of street artists since coming over to the United States.
But they're...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're something special.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
“Whew, I had a blast!
Thanks for listening, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Wait, don't tell us that you're done!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “We wanna hear more!”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Haha. Sorry, you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
“We have plans after this.
I promised Becky that we'd only sing for a little bit, so we have to call things here for today!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Please! We beg you!”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Hmm... I don't know, guys...”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Did we just make eye contact?)

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
“I've got a great idea...!
Hey, hey, Becky! Look!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Wh-What's going on?
Those two seem really interested in me for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
“Oh, that is a nice idea...
That should let us end things on a high note.”

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: “But only if she says yes.”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Okay! Then, I'll try asking her!”
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “Hey, you there!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Huh? Me...?”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
“Yeah, you!
You're the girl who was singing earlier this morning, yeah?”

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: “You wanna sing with us?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did she just invite Kohane to sing with them?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
S-Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you!
My name's Elena!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, you speak Japanese...?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: The way you sang sent a jolt through me. I've been wanting to sing with you all day!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Becky... Oh, umm... My little sister also wants to sing with you. So, what do you say?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What do I do?)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Huh? Is she gonna sing with them?”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “I've never seen her before...”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, everyone's looking at me now!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was honestly a little startled at first, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I was really drawn to their singing style.
It was so powerful, but so free and fun too.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (How would it feel to sing alongside that?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Umm... Sorry, you guys.
Would you mind waiting here for a minute?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Go have fun!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's go!
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There she goes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah...
What are they gonna sing?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've got this, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
Thanks for agreeing to do this!
I'm Rebecca. Call me Becky!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Nice to meet you! My name is Kohane Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Becky's Japanese is really good too...)

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
Kohane? Got it!
We can't sing the same song again, so...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Why don't we take turns singing to this beat?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, that sounds good!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Alright, then... Let's have a good time, girls♪

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Whoa, that girl... She looks all timid, but she's got some real pipes!”

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: “Haha. I can't wait to see how those two from illys respond!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(...!
They really are amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I knew it when I heard them earlier...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But these two sing at such a high level!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The way they create a rhythm and modulate their voices... What they're doing is really complicated, but they make it look so easy.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's proof of how refined their technique is!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They look like they're having so much fun!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can tell that Elena and Becky both really love to sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I know how they feel.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because I really love to sing too!)

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
“Oh, this is good!
But we're still just getting started!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
Their energy is insane!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But Azusawa is keeping pace.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do it, Kohane~~~!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Whew! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: It's been a while since we got that pumped up!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I couldn't resist going all-out, either!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Haha. That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
Sorry about that, you guys.
Thanks for letting us borrow your teammate.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, that's okay. We were moved by your heartfelt performance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That was so awesome!
It was like you grabbed hold of my heart and shook it around like crazy...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. I was about ready to get up there with you.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Whoa, I wasn't expecting to get showered with so much praise! That's so kind of all of you♪

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
Let's sing again sometime if we get the chance.
We like to perform here from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Next time, let's all sing together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Anyway, thanks again! See you later!
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They blew through here like a storm...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. But man, they were incredible singers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Especially the older one...
She felt so free while she sang.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Becky's technique was also really amazing!
She did a bunch of tricky things, but made everything look so easy. I was totally entranced.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And you looked like you had a blast too, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I did! I could tell exactly what they were feeling, and things just kept getting more fun as we sang.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I got to see something new again...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Those two said that they sing here from time to time, so I hope we run into them again before we leave the US...!)
New York - Alleyway
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <...and Kohane ended up singing with those girls?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It was super awesome. The crowd went totally wild.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I see. I would've liked to see that.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They said that they sing there from time to time, so we may encounter them again if we're lucky.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We'll make sure to let you know when that happens, Miku. They really are amazing singers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm looking forward to it already.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I think I see it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That must be the venue for the flea market.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, this is amazing...
Look at all the shops...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Secondhand clothing, tableware, antique objects, paintings... They've really got it all.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's quite the selection. Where should we begin?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I wanna check out that shop's trinkets and stuff, but I'm also interested in the clothes over there!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, but I also see some really nice accessories over there... I-I can't decide...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It seems we may be here quite a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah... I'm getting kinda hungry, so I'm gonna go buy a hot dog. Make up your mind before I get back, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, a real hot dog stand? I'd like to see what that's like.>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then, let's go together.
You want one, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll get two.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Umm... “Two hot dogs, please.”

rows.Speaker: Vendor
rows.Line: “$4.95 for one, and $9.90 for two!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: $9.90, got it. Where's my wallet...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That boy's sprinting straight this way for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<...!
Akito, look out!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Akito?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah... Sorry, Miku.
I dropped my phone...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Forget about me! Right now...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You need to get your wallet back!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That boy just ran off with your wallet!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Your wallet got stolen?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seriously?! Which way did he go?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, wait! He may be carrying a weapon. It's too dangerous to chase after him without a plan!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
“Tourists are so easy!
And there's plenty of people here, so I should be able to get away...”
se_run_men_001_2
“Hey, we saw that!”
“That wallet doesn't belong to you, now does it?”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What's going on over there?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Did someone catch him for us?!
We gotta go see!
se_run_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, they're...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The twins we met that time...?!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: “If you know what's good for you, then you'll stop picking people's pockets!”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: “Sh-Shut up!”
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, there he goes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm glad they were able to get your wallet back safely. But...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Long time no see, you guys!
Here's your wallet, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Th-Thanks... I appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More importantly, what are you guys doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
We came to do some shopping.
This area's more or less where we're based.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: We just happened to spot you guys.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: But just as we were coming to talk to you, that kid came by and took your wallet. So, we decided to catch him.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Again, I really appreciate it...
But to think that we'd meet again like this.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Haha. I know, right?!
But it really is nice to see you guys again.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Just a guess, but... Does this mean you guys are here to see SONIC NOTES?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Taiga's performing, after all.
Also, there was no way you'd miss such a big event.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Not if you're aiming to be world-class.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You guys said that when we met you in Japan. You're serious about standing on top of the world too, huh.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, you two said that you knew Aunt Nagi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How is it that you guys knew her?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
We were in such a rush that we didn't get a chance to explain.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: I know! We should go to a cafe or something and have us a nice, long chat! How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Wait, don't just assume that they're free.
You can see they're in the middle of sightseeing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're totally fine to join you guys!
We don't have any plans until SONIC NOTES starts, so I'd sure love to ask you two some questions.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Then, we can talk at this one cafe we go to all the time. The coffee there's really amazing!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Amazing coffee?
That sounds very nice.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
Then, we'll lead the way.
Follow us, you guys.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, we're right behind you!
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, this is delicious.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The acidity and bitterness are exquisitely balanced. I can tell they pay close attention not only to the quality of their beans, but to the preparation as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This whipped cream on top isn't too sweet either, so it works really well!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Mmm... Their cafe au lait's good stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: I'm glad you're all enjoying everything.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Your drinks were made using the beans Ceddy always gets, Toya, Kohane! So, it's nice to hear that they're to your liking!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. You and I may have a lot in common, Cedric.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You also mentioned that you can purchase beans here, so I'd appreciate it if you showed me which ones later.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah, no problem.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we've had a chance to properly reintroduce ourselves, let's get down to business.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... You're talking about how you two know RADder, yes?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
That's right.
Still, where do we begin...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wanna hear it all! For example, how did you two meet Aunt Nagi and her team?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
How we first met?
Actually, it's not all that different from the way we met all of you today...
